title: TAMIU Petroleum Engineering Program Receives $3.8M Software Donation from Petex
excerpt: TAMIU's Petroleum Engineering program received a software donation valued at $3,816,620 from Petex, a 10-year license for 50 seats of the company's MOVE suite modeling software.
content:
Texas A&M International University's Petroleum Engineering program has received a software donation valued at $3,816,620 from Petex (PE Limited), according to TAMIU.

The donation provides a 10-year license for 50 seats of Petex's MOVE suite software. The suite's advanced 2D and 3D modeling tools will be used to teach geological modeling, structural analysis, subsurface interpretation and related skills, preparing students for the energy industry.

Dr. Mousa J. Mohsen, director of TAMIU's School of Engineering, said the initiative aligns with TAMIU's mission to prepare students for the energy industry of tomorrow and that the software is used by leading oil and gas companies.

The MOVE suite will also be integrated into other TAMIU programs, including Engineering, Environmental Science and Math. Petex is a global leader in providing software solutions to the oil and gas industry.

TAMIU's Petroleum Engineering program is part of the A.R. Sanchez, Jr. School of Business. Founded in 2021, it is the only petroleum engineering degree program in South Texas.

Source: Texas A&M International University (tamiu.edu) — “TAMIU Petroleum Engineering Program Receives $3.8M Software Donation” (Nov. 4, 2026). tamiu.edu
